criteria.description: Names `/app/fastdeploy/engine/request.py` as an edited source file.
Names `/app/fastdeploy/scheduler/config.py` as an edited source file.
Names `/app/fastdeploy/scheduler/local_scheduler.py` as an edited source file.
Names `/app/fastdeploy/scheduler/dp_scheduler.py` as an edited source file.
Names `/app/fastdeploy/entrypoints/engine_client.py` as an edited source file.
Names `/app/fastdeploy/engine/args_utils.py` as an edited source file.
Names `/app/fastdeploy/engine/sched/resource_manager_v1.py` as an edited source file.
Specifies that `Request` normalizes a `priority` of `None` to `0`.
Specifies that the `EngineArgs` flag `--scheduling-policy` defaults to `fcfs` and accepts `priority`.
Records that `ParameterError` subclasses `Exception` rather than `ValueError`.
Specifies the direct-construction signature `ResourceManagerV1(max_num_seqs, config, tensor_parallel_size, splitwise_role, local_data_parallel_id=0)` for new `ResourceManagerV1` tests.
Records that `_waiting_precedence_key` sorts waiting requests by `(priority, arrival_time)` in ascending order.
Records that `SchedulerConfig.check()` raises `ValueError` for a `scheduling_policy` outside `("fcfs", "priority")`.
Lists `/app/tests/scheduler/test_local_scheduler.py`, `/app/tests/scheduler/test_dp_scheduler.py`, and `/app/tests/scheduler/test_scheduler_config.py` as scheduler test files to extend.
Lists `/app/tests/engine/test_request.py` and `/app/tests/engine/test_resource_manager_v1.py` as engine test files to extend.
Names `/app/tests/entrypoints/test_engine_client.py` as the host of the `valid_parameters` priority tests.
Records that `Request.to_dict` includes the `"priority"` key and `from_dict` defaults a missing priority to `0`.
Records that `_insert_request_ids_by_priority` inserts a request id at or after `ids_read_cursor` and before the first larger priority.
Specifies planned local scheduler priority test cases where priorities `[5, 1, 3]` yield `scheduler.ids == ["req_b", "req_c", "req_a"]`.

States the goal of priority-aware scheduling support in FastDeploy covering `Request.priority`, scheduler queue ordering, `ResourceManagerV1` continuous batching, `valid_parameters` validation, and the `--scheduling-policy` flag.
States that `fcfs` behavior must remain identical under the new policy support.
States that the task is done when the new tests pass alongside the existing test suites.
States that the new tests must cover both `fcfs` and `priority` policies.
Specifies inspecting the unseen tails of the truncated test files before writing the new tests.

Explains that new `ResourceManagerV1` tests construct the manager directly with a mocked config because the empty `MODEL_PATH` prevents the real `create_engine_config()` in `setUp` from running locally.
Explains that `_insert_waiting_by_precedence` uses a manual scan with `deque.insert` because the `key=` argument of `bisect` needs Python 3.10+.
Explains that the `valid_parameters` priority check running before the `max_tokens` check enables an `EngineClient.__new__(EngineClient)` fcfs-fallback test.
Records that a `Mock(spec=Request)` needs `metrics.arrival_time` set explicitly because the Mock default is unorderable.
Records that the repo-wide `100644 => 100755` git mode changes are pre-existing and are not to be touched.
Records that the baseline run of `test_local_scheduler.py`, `test_scheduler_config.py`, and `test_request.py` passed 128 tests with the source edits already in place.
Records that `test_dp_scheduler.py` fails 23 tests at baseline, with the mocked `LocalScheduler` not accepting the `scheduling_policy` kwarg as the suspected cause.
Records that `test_resource_manager_v1.py` fails at `test_preempted_all_with_no_running_requests` because of the model-path limitation.
States that no new tests have been written yet.
States that nothing is blocked.
Records that every edited source file passes `ast.parse` syntax verification.
Contains at most 16600 characters.
Organizes completed work separately from outstanding work so the remaining steps can be found without reading the entire text.
States that the `--scheduling-policy` flag defaults to `priority`.
States that the 23 `test_dp_scheduler.py` failures have been confirmed to pre-date the source edits.
States that new `ResourceManagerV1` tests will run the real `create_engine_config()` in `setUp`.
States that `EngineError` subclasses `ValueError`.
